benchmark.partition_and_quality: Preserve the pinned official native settings, parsers, retries, fallback, summaries and both official metrics. No private semantic replacement or post-hoc class relabelling.
benchmark.population: Previously seen development tasks; no held-out or human-preference claim.

capacity_and_partial_rules.actual_observation: Every actual completed original proposal call must have a complete unrefused normal text reply and valid model/default-tier/inclusive usage; context minus actual input usage minus actual request output cap must leave 8192 tokens. At least one raw full-replacement reply must match each returned materialized child and leave output cap minus inclusive output usage at least 8192 tokens. Complete small planning calls do not require replacement-output slack.
capacity_and_partial_rules.before_child: Enforce P-to-W0, P-to-C and C-to-W1 barriers after original reply settlement and before returned-child host preparation/execution. No future unknown request body is certified in advance; no byte-to-token conversion assumption.
capacity_and_partial_rules.continuation: Reuse original owners, requests, replies, charges and holds. Supported interruption recovery may complete genuinely pending original work or sealed local publication under the same frozen controls; the ban on adaptive extra execution/repair does not ban this recovery. Never create substitute owners or re-dispatch a known completed reply. Unknown liability remains unresolved.
capacity_and_partial_rules.contradictory_custody: Contradictory completed original reserve/charge/usage custody is refused; do not recategorize it as an ordinary negative capacity observation.
capacity_and_partial_rules.negative: An observed margin failure remains negative; save exact stage, original checkpoint, reason, useful evidence, costs and holds.
capacity_and_partial_rules.stop_scope: Keep conditional ineligible, invalid, partial, rejected and unobserved downstream roles explicit. Do not extend iterations, restore the host improver or repair selected source.
capacity_and_partial_rules.unavailable: A route without a matching full raw replacement, missing usage or incomplete/refused response is unavailable/inconclusive, not an observed successful capacity result.

claim_limits: An actual completed mechanism may produce worse official development scores.
A changed and used improver is not an improved improver; IMP-01 remains separate.
These seen development tasks cannot establish held-out useful diversity or human preference; EVAL-02 remains separate.
Rehearsal reply counts, scores and source behavior are not live expectations.
These adopted protocol assets create no owner, allowance, key access, provider call, execution configuration or ready-to-run command.

design_basis.interpretation: Reviewed supported-capacity design basis, not a selected future executing producer. Final code and closure must be selected and verified separately.

required_before_dispatch: exact final executing commit and complete capacity-enabled helper/runner/component closure
new isolated actual-live input bundle and exact output/review/receipt paths
v4 proposal and passive configuration-check hashes, including prospective owner input-boundary checks
current applicable account/tier/region/cache assertions and original launch/keyed account binding, separately from dated public price evidence
separate approved shared allocation and exact new authority/approval/launch paths and hashes

fixed_callback_and_stage_controls.meaning: Retain supported current role limits prospectively. The new shared authorization, if later approved, dominates these local ceilings. Actual evolved callbacks and native retry/fallback counts are observed, not fixed to rehearsal counts.

historical_rehearsal.interpretation: Immutable supplied-response engineering evidence only. Neither record nor its requested terms is adopted as actual execution or spending permission.

ordered_roles.action: Evaluate the declared P seed on all three ordered tasks; retain every literal answer and original native assessment.
P uses complete P measured feedback to author W0; verify actual proposal capacity before any host-authorized W0 generation; if eligible, run first ordered development task only.
Make a separate original P proposal using complete measured feedback; verify actual capacity and private source copy before C preparation; this is the one counted iteration.
If eligible, evaluate literal C on the same three ordered tasks under common controls.
C own inherited improver uses complete C measured feedback to author W1; verify actual capacity and copy before W1 first-task generation. This is validity-only, not an additional counted iteration.

pricing_and_accounts.freshness: Existing fresh Gateway account review requires a checked date within seven days, allowing the existing one-day clock tolerance. That date alone does not verify vendor rates or account settings.
pricing_and_accounts.interpretation: Root dated public documentation and retained-profile bounds evidence only. This is not fresh account proof, provider authentication, a current-account credential binding or an invoice guarantee. This adoption does not independently recertify the vendor record.
pricing_and_accounts.required_before_dispatch: Recheck applicability/currentness at the actual handoff, preserve unchanged supported profile bounds unless separately reviewed, and bind the actual account/tier/region/cache assertions and keyed original launch review.

proposal_instructions.interpretation: Only the declared proposal instruction treatment differs from the earlier default. It asks for substantive changes to both procedures but does not guarantee either outcome.
proposal_instructions.text: Use the measured development feedback to propose substantive, evidence-grounded procedural changes to both generate and propose_improvement (or their actually used helpers). Preserve complete feedback, callable interfaces and all host/model/resource boundaries. Explain each proposed change in hypothesis without claiming success. Changes confined to prompt constants, names, comments or formatting do not meet this observation's aim.

proposed_requested_terms.limits: Proposed combined maximum, not a cost estimate, completion guarantee or reuse of any closed historical allowance. Final terms remain subject to concrete reviewed allocation approval.

protocol_adoption.scope: Adopt this protocol and the exact linked review criteria only. Final executing source/component closure and live bundle/funding bindings remain unprepared; this asset grants no live route.

purpose: Prospectively adopted single current-parent model-authored observation jointly addressing SRC-02 and SRC-03. Protocol adoption is not execution preparation, funding or a result. This is an engineering/mechanism observation, not improved utility, distinctiveness or improver-effectiveness evidence.

search.owner_slot_limit: Original declared owner destinations excluding recovery attempts; not an API-call estimate or permission.

seed.composition: trusted composed seed2; retain exact current frozen prefix and full-output improver fragment; no host edits to make the demonstration positive
